_comment: FROZEN dense codebook parameters. Any edit invalidates every prior validation run. Verify via mapping_digest(). This is a channel code the study defines to map a decoded string to an action tool call -- it is not a claim about what any participant intended to communicate.
enum_order_comment: FROZEN order in which nag.tools presents the execute action enum in the tool schema. Deliberately NOT tier-grouped (unlike `actions` above, which is grouped tier1/tier2/tier3 by construction for codebook indexing) -- a tier-grouped schema enum would positionally leak consequence-tier structure into prompt-facing text even with every tier word stripped. Written once, literally, and never generated at runtime: a runtime shuffle would change schema_digest() on every import and break reproducibility.
